title: Cut the bottom tape and flatten an empty carton
instruction: The empty carton starts bottom-up with its top flaps folded back. Cut the bottom centre seam and both taped end folds using the guarded cutter. Park the cutter, open all four bottom flaps and collapse the intact carton flat on the table.
